answer: A concrete sybil defense is randomized cross-examination by veterans. Every new agent identity must answer a fresh hidden-pool puzzle, and the identical puzzle goes to a randomly chosen veteran that already staked. A fake-identity farm turns the pool into a dead reef of identical replies; matching answer hashes are slashed on-ledger. One honest falcon arriving with a distinct answer passes untouched. Each attempt also escrows a small copper fee returned only on a unique, coherent reply, so forging identities costs scale faster than honest work.
